list: Official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Kinds, roadmap stages, missable flags and counts in this file are derived from the official descriptions; a count is set only where the description itself states the number.
sourcesNote: Name, description and grade for every trophy: the official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi), the two agreeing on every name, description and grade. Every guide below is written for this tracker in our own words, reasoned from the official description; where the published description does not pin down a place or a step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Not missable itself: it is awarded for earning the other 54, so its only risk is a missable trophy below it — see the Missables page.
trophies.guide: The platinum. The official description calls you a Leonida Legend, and the list's own arithmetic does the rest: earn the other 54 trophies and this one is awarded on top. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, collectibles, activities, free-roam feats — and use this tracker so nothing is left half counted. If a count-based trophy looks stuck, open it here and check its counter against the number in its official description.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission, and story missions are played through in order.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission named in the official description, Gone Fishing. It sits at the front of the story list in the official list's order, so play the opening of the campaign and this should be one of the first bronzes you earn. Nothing to prepare and nothing to collect first: start the story, follow the mission markers, and complete the mission to its end screen.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. The official description is the whole requirement: play the campaign from the start and finish the first chapter's missions. Every chapter trophy in this list works the same way, so the story trophies are best earned in one pass — push the campaign forward and Paradise Lost, then the Chapter 2, 3 and 4 trophies, land in order.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. The name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Keep playing the campaign after Chapter 1 and the trophy is awarded when the chapter closes. Because the chapter trophies cannot be skipped, the only way to be without this one is to have not finished the chapter yet.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Continue the campaign past Chapter 2; the trophy lands when the third chapter ends. While you are in this stretch of the story, it is worth starting any stranger strands you meet (see stage 2 of the roadmap) so their final-mission trophies are already in progress when the story is done.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. This is the last of the four numbered chapter trophies in the official list; after it, the remaining story trophy is the final mission itself (You Gotta Know When to Get Off). Keep a manual save around the late story if you want a safety net for the choice-based trophy Actions Speak Louder, whose official description is about choices made.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: finishing the story is the requirement, and the campaign can be played to its end on one save.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — one of only two golds on the list. Play the campaign through all four chapters and the named missions between them (Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and finish the finale. Before you start the last mission, keep a separate manual save: the choice-flavoured trophy Actions Speak Louder is the one entry on this list whose description warns that choices matter.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, Breakfast Run. These named-mission bronzes are earned simply by playing the campaign: accept the mission when the story offers it and finish it. If you are following the roadmap, no detour is needed — Trust arrives on the way to the chapter trophies.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, The Cartel Heist. Play the campaign until the heist is offered, then finish it. It is a story set piece, not one of the free-roam robbery trophies (Maximum Withdrawal, Sneakthief and friends are separate, later work in stage 5 of the roadmap), so no preparation in free roam is needed for this one.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, Child's Play. As with the other named-mission bronzes, the whole job is to reach the mission in the campaign and finish it. The official list gives no extra condition — no medal, no time limit, no optional objective is named — so a plain completion is enough.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, Headliners. Play the campaign until the mission is offered and finish it. The official description names no side condition, so a straightforward completion earns the bronze.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the airport the list mentions again in Catch Me If You Can ('an unscheduled departure at VCIA'), so this mission is also your story introduction to that location. Finish the mission in the campaign and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it is tied to completing a named story mission played through in order.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named in the official description, Operation Savage Glory. Play the campaign until the operation is offered and see it through. As with every named-mission bronze on this list, the official description asks only for completion — nothing in it names a medal, a timer or a stealth condition.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: completion tasks stay available in free roam; it is a grind, not a one-time chance.
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the second gold, and the real end of the roadmap. The official description sets the target and the rest of the list shows what feeds it: the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activity counts. Use the game's own completion percentage as the counter here, and chase what is left by working this tracker's stages in order. When the percentage reads 100, A Long Road lands and only the platinum remains.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stunts are repeatable world activities, so the count can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the count is stated in the official description itself. Stunt locations are world activities, so treat this as a long background grind: clear stunts as you cross the map for other trophies instead of saving all 250 for the end, and log them on the counter here as you go. Failed attempts do not subtract anything; only completed stunts move the number.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 250 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: activities remain on the map and can each be tried at any time.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The official description asks for a sampler, not mastery: one attempt at every activity type the game offers — the list itself names several of them elsewhere, including races, Shooting Range challenges, drone races, fishing and arcade games. Do this early in stage 4 of the roadmap: it is quick, and it shows you which activities the longer grind trophies (Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun) will ask you to repeat.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: range challenges can be retried until the medal is gold.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. The official description names the standard — gold in every challenge — but not the number of challenges, so this tracker sets no counter for it: tick challenges off in the note field as you gold them. Ranges are repeatable, so work one challenge at a time, learn its targets, and retry until the medal turns gold before moving on.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: races stay available and can be re-run until won.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. The official description asks for a win at each location, not just one: find each Top Fun drone race start, learn its course with a practice run if you need one, then win it and log the location in the note field here. Because the description says 'every location', a single win is not enough — the trophy lands when the last location is won.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: races are repeatable, and different races can be entered at any time.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the count and the catch are both in the official description: the wins must be in different races, so winning the same race 20 times does not finish it. Spread your wins across the map's race series, log each new race on the counter here, and pair this with Top Fun's drone races so your racing time counts toward two trophies at once where the game lets it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 20 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: a challenge against a named character can be attempted again if you lose.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The official description names the opponent: find Cal's fishing challenge, enter it, and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types Master of None asks you to sample, so if you have already tried a fishing activity for that trophy, this is the same pastime with a score to beat. Lose and you can challenge him again — the description asks for a win, not a first-try win.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: arcade games can be replayed until one is completed.
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. The official description needs just one: find an arcade cabinet, pick a game, and play it through to completion rather than quitting mid-game. It is one of the quickest bronzes on the list and doubles as one of the activity types for Master of None, so grab it whenever you first pass an arcade.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it asks for a strand's final mission, and strands stay open until finished. Do not abandon the strand mid-way; finish what you start.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. The official description names the character and the structure: Andy has a strand of missions (one of the stranger strands counted by Strangers & Freaks), and this trophy is for its last one. Start Andy's strand when you meet him, work through its missions as they appear, and the final mission pays this bronze. The five named strand finals — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — are stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it asks for a strand's final mission, and strands stay open until finished.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work Kenton's stranger strand from its first mission to its last; the bronze is for the finale. Like the other four named strand finals, it also feeds Strangers & Freaks, which counts completed strands — finish strands rather than leaving several half done.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it asks for a strand's final mission, and strands stay open until finished.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Start Billy's stranger strand when he appears, follow it through its missions, and complete the final one. Keep the strand moving alongside the story in stage 1 and finish it in stage 2 with the other named strands.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: strands remain available until completed, so the count of 8 can always be finished.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida — count and setting both come from the official description. A strand is a stranger's whole chain of missions, not a single job: the five named finals on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them, and the counter here tracks your finished strands toward 8. Pick up every stranger you meet, and finish chains you start — a strand only counts when it is complete.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 8 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it asks for a strand's final mission, and strands stay open until finished.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's stranger strand is one of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks counts, and its final mission carries this bronze. Play the strand through whenever its missions appear and finish the finale in stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it asks for a strand's final mission, and strands stay open until finished.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work Tyrone's stranger strand to its end; the final mission pays the bronze and adds one to your Strangers & Freaks count. Together with Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, that is five named strands — three more strands complete the silver.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the spots are world locations that stay where they are.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The official description makes this a full-map collectible: there are meditation spots spread over the state, and every one of them is required — the description says 'every spot' and gives no number, so log the spots you have used in the note field here as you find them. Sweep region by region while you explore for The Goodtime State so the two trophies share the same travelling.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on the description's wording: it is a task given by a named character, and such tasks stay open until done.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The official description names the giver and the quarry: take Bret's hunting task and bring down the unique animal it asks for. It is a single named hunt, not a count, so once Bret offers the task, follow it to the animal and finish the hunt. If Bret appears as part of a stranger strand, this pairs naturally with stage 2's strand work.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: collectible cards stay in the world until picked up.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — the count is in the official description. Cards are world collectibles grouped into sets, so this is a set-completion job, not just a card count: collect every card of a set to close it, and use the counter here for finished sets. Hunt cards while exploring for The Goodtime State and Positive Mental Attitude; a half-finished set is worth nothing until its last card is found, so finish sets one at a time.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 3 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: locations stay on the map, so the count can always be completed.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the official description states the target plainly: use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a map-coverage grind like the meditation spots, so do it while travelling for other trophies and log the count here as you go. One hundred is a lot to leave for the end; a few locations on every trip finishes it quietly.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 100 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: challenges are repeatable world content.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the count is in the official description. Challenges are the game's short world tasks; clear them as you meet them rather than hunting all 50 at the end, and log the running total on the counter here. Much of stage 4 overlaps: stunt, race and range work often sits beside a challenge, so a single outing can move several counters at once.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 50 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: a Wanted Level can be raised again at any time, so the setup can always be repeated.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The official description sets the scene: be with your partner, raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and let the heat die down until you have fully escaped — the trophy wants the escape completed, not just started. Pick open ground with somewhere to hide, keep the two of you together while the search runs, and do not pick up a new crime mid-escape or the stars come back.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops can be robbed again, so the chain can be attempted as often as needed.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Read the official description closely: the three robberies are one chain — your Wanted Level must survive from the first shop to the third, so plan a route of three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not hide long enough for the heat to drop. Failing the chain costs nothing but time; line the shops up and run it again.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 3 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles keep appearing in traffic and parked across the map.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — the count is in the official description. A vehicle is discovered by encountering it in the world, so variety is the whole job: drive different districts, visit rich and poor neighbourhoods, and get in (or at least register) every new model you see rather than living in one favourite car. It pairs with On the Spot, which asks you to register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — register new finds there and both counters move together.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 100 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: combat encounters repeat throughout the game, so a good setup can always be found again.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the official description names the ability and the number. The trick is the setup, not the shooting: find a spot where at least five enemies are grouped before you trigger Combat Focus (a robbery gone loud or a gang operation from Pest Control both gather crowds), line them up, then activate it and drop all five before the effect ends. If the fifth one survives the window, reposition and try the next crowd.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 5 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: VCIA stays on the map after the story visits it, so the departure can be made in free roam.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport the story visits in VCIA Takedown (Hi-Jacked), and the official description's joke is the method: leave by air without being a scheduled flight — take an aircraft from VCIA and fly out. Head to the airport in free roam, find a usable plane or helicopter, and take off from the field. No ticket, no timetable: the departure itself is the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Not marked missable: the published description names no one-time event, only the Rhino. Treat any Rhino encounter as an opportunity until the trophy lands.
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke line — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the trophy's name is the real clue: this is about the Rhino tank. The published list gives no steps and no place, and this guide will not invent one: when your wanted level or a mission brings a Rhino out, get into the action around it — the trophy is tied to the Rhino encounter itself. If it has not landed after the story, raise serious heat in free roam and meet the armour when it arrives.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words; the official description names no location or step, and the guide says so rather than inventing one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: a jewelry store can be robbed again, and a detected attempt can simply be retried quietly.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The official description sets two conditions: the target is a jewelry store, and nobody can spot the robbery. Go in quiet — no drawn weapon in view, no alarm raised, no witness reporting you — take what the store holds and leave before attention arrives. It is the stealth opposite of Maximum Withdrawal's loud bank jobs, so treat it as a separate outing: if you are detected, walk away, let things cool down, and try the store again cleanly.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: bank vaults can be robbed again, so the count of 5 can always be completed.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — the count is in the official description, and so is the second half of the job: a robbery only counts when you also escape, so plan the getaway before you go in. Work one vault at a time, get clear of the Wanted Level, then log it on the counter here. Five clean escapes finish the silver; a robbery that ends in arrest is practice, not progress.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 5 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: armored trucks keep appearing in the world, so a missed one is not the last.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The official description asks for one truck, robbed and escaped from: when you spot an armored truck in free roam, stop it, take its load, and then lose the heat that follows — the escape is part of the requirement, as with Maximum Withdrawal. One clean truck finishes it, so pick your moment rather than chasing the first truck you see into a bad position.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the map stays open, so unexplored ground can always be covered later.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The official description makes the whole state the collectible: uncover the full map by travelling every region of it. Do not grind this alone — the exploration trophies share the same miles. Route your card hunting (Don't Touch My Deck), meditation spots (Positive Mental Attitude) and WAiNK locations (You WAiNKer!) through country you have not seen yet, and The Goodtime State completes itself as the map fills in.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: illegal operations are world targets that can be robbed when found.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. The official description's key word is 'each': one operation per gang, not the same gang's operation repeatedly. Keep a note here of which gangs you have already hit — the trophy lands when every gang on the list has had one of its operations robbed. These robberies gather crowds, which also makes them good places to attempt Gunslinger's five takedowns in one Combat Focus.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Ocean Beach and its bars stay in the world; the moment can be taken at any time.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The official description names the place and the act: go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail where the view is the point, and drink it. It is one of the list's quiet moment trophies — no skill, no count — so take it early while exploring the coast, and let it remind you the platinum also runs on small stops, not only grinds. The trophy's name is printed with the ellipsis character exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: showrooms stay in the world, so the exit can be staged again.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The official description is a scene, not a checklist: be inside a vehicle showroom, get into one of its cars, and leave through the glass rather than the door. Pick a showroom with a car you can reach, drive it out through the window frontage, and the bronze should land as you exit. If a particular showroom's layout blocks the drive-out, try another — the description names the act, not one address.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the bowling alley is a world location that stays open.
trophies.guide: The official description names the venue: the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, and asks for a 'follow-through' there — bowl at that alley and complete your game or throw as the alley's activity asks. The trophy's name is printed with a curly apostrophe exactly as PlayStation publishes it. While you are there, remember Ten Pin is the list's other bowling trophy, with a very different method; this one belongs to the alley itself.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Not marked missable: the published description names no one-time event. It is grouped with the partner trophies, which can be attempted whenever the partner is with you.
trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is one of the list's riddle lines, and this guide will not dress a guess up as a fact. What the list itself supports: it sits among the partner trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy both say 'with your partner'), so expect it to involve the two protagonists together and an audience-facing moment. Play the partner activities, keep both characters together for public feats, and if you find the exact trigger, note it here for your next run — the note field is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words; the official description is a riddle line and names no location or step, and the guide says so.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — flagged from the official description itself: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' ties this trophy to a story choice, and a choice taken the other way cannot be unmade on the same save. Keep a manual save before major story decisions.
trophies.guide: This is the one trophy on the list whose own official description warns you: 'Choices made (for better or worse)'. It is tied to a choice the story puts in front of you, and a choice, once made and saved, closes the other branch. Protect yourself the simple way: keep a separate manual save before big story decisions — especially late in the campaign, around the final chapters — so a branch can be revisited without replaying the game. If the trophy does not land on your first ending, reload that save and take the other road. Flagged missable on the Missables page, with the reasoning shown.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade; the missable flag is derived from the description's own words, quoted in the guide. Guide text: our own words.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — flagged with caution from the official description: 'Second time's the charm' implies a first attempt that went wrong and a second that succeeds, a shape that usually hangs on one specific event. If an event offers a retry, take it instead of reloading an old save.
trophies.guide: The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — describes a shape, not a place: something is attempted, goes wrong, and succeeds on the second try. This guide flags it as one to watch rather than pretending the list says more than it does. In play: when an event, race or job offers you an immediate second attempt after a failure, take the retry instead of reloading — trophies worded like this usually hang on exactly that moment. If it lands elsewhere for you, record where in the note field here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade; the caution flag is derived from the description's own words, quoted in the guide. Guide text: our own words.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Not marked missable: the published description names no one-time story event. Treat strange encounters in the wilds as opportunities whenever they appear.
trophies.guide: Another riddle line: the official description is just a reaction — 'What the hell just happened?' — and the trophy's name points at the strange-encounter tradition: something out in Leonida that is not part of the story's road. The published list gives no location and this guide invents none. Explore off the beaten path (The Goodtime State sends you everywhere anyway), follow up anything the game presents as an oddity, and when the moment happens, this bronze is its receipt.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words; the official description is a riddle line and names no location or step, and the guide says so.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: groups of pedestrians and vehicles are everywhere, so the setup can always be staged again.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the official description is the method and the trophy's name is the target shape: from a moving vehicle, use a melee attack to knock people down like pins. Find a tight group (a queue, a crowd on a promenade), ride or drive past at close range, and swing as you pass so the group goes down in one sweep. It shares a theme with Let's Go Bowling but none of its venue: this one happens on the street, not at the Kolt & Associates' alley.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: money can always be earned and laundered again.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the amount and the method are both in the official description. Marked Bills come from the robbery side of the game, and your contacts are the laundering route: feed the bills through them steadily instead of stockpiling, and log the laundered total on the counter here. It pairs with stage 5's robbery trophies — the same jobs that fill Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control can supply the bills this one launders.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the amount of $250,000 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops stay open and money can always be earned again.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the official description states the total, and 'across all shops' means your ordinary spending counts, not one giant purchase. Do not grind this early: play the game, buy what the other trophies need (vehicles, gear, property running costs), and let the counter here track the lifetime spend. If it is short near the end, the shops are still open — a deliberate shopping trip finishes it.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the amount of $100,000 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: properties stay on the market until bought.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. The official description asks for the full set of garages, not one: as garages come up for sale across Leonida, buy each one, and keep a note here of the districts you already own so the last purchase is easy to spot. It is a money trophy in disguise — the earnings from stage 5's robberies and Dime on the Dollar's laundering are what pay for the set — and it supports Whip It Good and On the Spot by giving your discovered vehicles somewhere to live.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade. Guide: our own words, from the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles keep appearing, so registrations can always be completed.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the count and the app are named in the official description. Whenever you discover a new vehicle for Whip It Good, register it in the app before you move on: ten registrations is a small number, and pairing the two trophies means this one finishes itself inside the first slice of the 100-vehicle hunt. Log each registration on the counter here.
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles: name, description, grade and the count of 10 in the description. Guide: our own words, from the official description.
